community_list_entries.name: Ground Truth First: A Longitudinal Evaluation Instrument for Agent Memory, and the Tenure Crossover in Memory-Architecture Rankings

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A longitudinal evaluation instrument with a synthetic life-script corpus: 383 questions of 15 types over chat and email histories (14 short-horizon users and 6 users with 9-week tenure histories). Question types include knowledge updates, expired state, preferences, episodic, temporal, multi-session
